day_shape: CENTCOM helicopter disabled Panama-flagged M/V Vela Nova in Gulf of Oman under US blockade of Iran, Pakistan says US-Iran deal nearing, IAEA to remove Syrian nuclear material, Khamenei reshuffles IRGC/General Staff, and WSJ reports Iranian plot against Trump's Air Force One.

threads.label: US blockade and Hormuz maritime clashes
threads.summary: CENTCOM said an MH-60 fired two Hellfire missiles into the engine room of Panama-flagged M/V Vela Nova after it ignored warnings while heading to an Iranian port. Iran International reported Houthis struck a ship in Bab el-Mandeb killing two Pakistanis and an Indonesian, while Pakistan and Qatar signalled Hormuz mediation progress.

threads.label: Khamenei military reshuffle
threads.summary: Iran International reported the reshuffle consolidates command under Mojtaba Khamenei with Ahmad Vahidi named IRGC commander-in-chief, Mostafa Izadi deputy, Ali Abdollahi Chief of General Staff and Kiumars Heidari deputy. Khamenei's channel published expectations for the new commanders while IRGC, army and intelligence chiefs issued congratulatory messages.

threads.label: Reported Iranian plot against Trump
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post, citing WSJ and a US official, reported Israel provided intelligence on an Iranian threat to Trump including possible shoulder-fired missiles against Air Force One, prompting a secret operation last month flying him from Turkey to the UK on an alternate aircraft. Trump told reporters at Joint Base Andrews he is "the last person to trust Iran."

threads.label: Syria nuclear material removal
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported the IAEA will remove nuclear material from a clandestine Syrian site under an agreement between the US, Syria and Israel, with a delegation due in Damascus in coming days. Separately, a Syrian court convicted former president Bashar al-Assad of crimes against humanity and sentenced him to death.

threads.label: US-Iran mediation signals
threads.summary: Pakistani Defence Minister Khawaja Muhammad Asif told Bloomberg in Islamabad that the US and Iran are nearing an agreement. Iran International noted Pakistan and Qatar signalled progress on Hormuz mediation, while SNSC secretary Mohsen Rezaei told China's ambassador "America must end the war."

threads.label: Lebanon and Erbil strikes
threads.summary: Lebanese media reported an Israeli drone strike on a vehicle near Nabatieh followed by a second strike on a Hezbollah-linked ambulance team, with the IDF later denying a Nabatieh strike. Jerusalem Post and IRIB reported four drones struck a training camp of the Iranian Kurdish opposition northeast of Erbil, with security sources blaming Iran.

threads.label: Regime posture and defiance messaging
threads.summary: Defa Press quoted deputy commander-in-chief Sheikh saying Iran manages the Strait of Hormuz by "geopolitical logic," IRGC spokesman Mohebbi claiming no US warship remains in the Persian Gulf, and adviser Naghdi saying all weapons are domestically produced. Khamenei's channel republished a message warning "criminals" would not die peacefully.

events.title: Lebanese media reports that a vehicle was targeted in an Israeli drone strike on the outskirts of Nabatieh this morning. Lebanon's National News Agency adds that an ambulance team from the Hezbollah-linked Islamic Health Authority, Islamic Message Scouts Association, and other medical personnel was hit by a second strike while transporting an injured person in the area. The IDF has not yet commented.
events.summary:
Lebanese media reports that a vehicle was targeted in an Israeli drone strike on the outskirts of Nabatieh this morning.

Lebanon's National News Agency adds that an ambulance team from the Hezbollah-linked Islamic Health Authority, Islamic Message Scouts Association, and other medical personnel was hit by a second strike while transporting an injured person in the area.

The IDF has not yet commented.
